messages:
Samir: Heads up — Cloud marketplace onboarding with CloudNexus + AtlasHW is next Wed. We need to lock the partner SEV flow + shared-channel warroom triggers. Proposed minimal play: 1) shared channel with partner (#shared-cloudnexus-redwood) 2) severity mapping: P0 -> immediate warroom + PagerDuty page, P1 -> shared channel ping + 30m SLA 3) OpsBot posts normalized alert + short context to shared channel 4) automatic fallback to 'small-model' variant when latency > 500ms 5) post-incident summary to partner mailing list. Thoughts?
Tia: +1 on the structure. Quick Q: partner prefers a shared channel or a DM bridge? They asked for shared but legal wants controls. We should document what goes into the shared channel vs. private warroom.
Maria: Can we also add a pinned runbook link in the shared channel and a short header template for incidents? I can prepare the template. Runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-onboarding-sev (internal)
Chris: Suggestion: include a model-fallback policy step in the runbook — when inference latency spikes, route to quantized variant and reduce max_tokens. Also include a capacity fallback to Dedicated pool if we detect queueing > 5s.
Devon: Escalation matrix I'd propose: P0 -> page SRE on-call (PagerDuty) -> 10m to acknowledge -> if not ack, exec warroom (bridge + shared channel elevation) -> notify partner liaison. P1 -> post in shared channel + message partner liaison -> 30m to onboard SRE. Keep it short and deterministic.
Samir: Nice. Roles: SRE oncall = Alex-SRE, Partner liaison = Tia, Customer Success lead = Maria, Eng on-call = Chris, Runbook owner = Devon. Can everyone confirm?
Alex-SRE: I can own the warroom bridge and the initial runbook steps for ops. I'll create a quick playbook snippet for bridge run (bridge -> record -> triage) and a checklist.
Tia: I confirm partner liaison. I'll also draft the partner-facing incident header (what we post to shared channel) and the approval checklist for shared-channel access.
Maria: Confirmed for CS lead. I'll pin the runbook and the contact matrix to #shared-cloudnexus-redwood once it's created. I'll also add a short postmortem template to the runbook.
Chris: Confirmed for eng on-call. I'll add the model-fallback knobs and example commands to change routing fast. Small snippet that we'll keep in the runbook:

```bash
# quick route to small-model variant
redwoodctl route set --customer cloudnexus --model small-quant --priority override
# reduce token cap
redwoodctl config set --customer cloudnexus --request_max_tokens 256
```

Devon: OpsBot payload we should send to the shared channel on alert (normalized). Example payload I'll add to runbook:

```json
{
  "alert_id": "{{alert_id}}",
  "severity": "P0",
  "summary": "High inference latency > 500ms (5m avg)",
  "runbook": "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-onboarding-sev#playbook",
  "actions": ["page:oncall","open:warroom","notify:partner-liaison"]
}
```

OpsBot: TEST ALERT -> simulated P0 triggered by latency test. Posting normalized alert to #shared-cloudnexus-redwood and paging oncall. Payload id=tb-20260314-01. :rotating_light:
Alex-SRE: Got the test page, acknowledging. I'll stand up a bridge in 2 minutes and post the bridge URL to the shared channel. :thumbsup:
Tia: Will send a short partner note once bridge URL is up. We'll mark this as DRY-RUN and ask partner to join if they have time.
Samir: Thanks all. Can we run a full dry-run Tue 10:00 PT? If everyone can please respond with :thumbsup: or propose another time.
Maria: :thumbsup: works for CS.
Chris: :thumbsup: I can do Tue 10.
Devon: :thumbsup: I'll run the OpsBot simulated alert and validate the PagerDuty path.
Alex-SRE: :thumbsup: I'll be on the bridge and test recording + logs export.
Tia: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the partner invite.
Samir: Great — I'll update the runbook with today's decisions and tag owners. One last ask: Maria, can you add a short line in the shared-channel topic with PD escalation steps and the PD escalation phone sequence? Example: "P0 -> page SRE -> 10m -> bridge -> escalate to on-call manager". Keep it minimal.
Maria: Will do. I'll also include the oncall contact list and a 'how to mute partner channel' note for privacy-sensitive items.
Samir: Perfect. Closing notes: aim for clear signals (PD page + OpsBot normalized alert) to avoid ad-hoc DMs. We'll keep partner channel for updates and bridge for live triage. Thanks everyone — will post the updated runbook link here when done.
OpsBot: NOTE: automated test completed, pager path validated. Logs available at https://redwood.internal/logs/test/tb-20260314-01. :white_check_mark:
Samir: Closing — dry-run Tue 10:00 PT. I'll make a calendar event and include the bridge link. Appreciate the quick sync. :rocket:
